# Kenney Space Kit

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/space-kit

Only the models used by the exterior mining-outpost prototype are included. The selection covers the
landing zone, two small facilities, machinery, vehicles, rocks, crystals and meteors without importing
the complete pack.

- `craft_cargoB.fbx`
- `rock_largeA.fbx`
- `rock_largeB.fbx`
- `rock.fbx`
- `rocks_smallA.fbx`
- `rocks_smallB.fbx`

- `hangar_smallB.fbx`
- `machine_barrel.fbx`
